notes: Reference text and character offsets are preserved.
Outside-reference audio may be represented by external CTC wildcards, never internal wildcards.
All reference words must be consumed in semi-global ASR comparison; internal edits retain their costs.
CTC scores are not calibrated probabilities of correct alignment.
Thresholds prioritize human review only, not final acceptance or tuned accuracy.
Human feedback informs method design, not retained as new validation data.
outer_boundary_implementation: Two virtual wildcard-only frames permit empty outer spans; discard virtual frames and shift token indices back before mapping time.
